meta_description: West Park Electrics is a trusted local electrician in Leeds. From fault finding to full rewires, we deliver safe, reliable work. Call 07889 228995 for a quote.
hero_subhead: From emergency call-outs to complete rewires, West Park Electrics delivers safe, professional work across Leeds.
services_subhead: Whether it's an emergency repair, a planned upgrade, or a full installation, we handle all aspects of domestic and light commercial electrical work.

services.title: Emergency Call-Outs
services.desc: Power cuts, blown fuses, tripped electrics? We respond to emergencies 24/7. Most faults diagnosed and repaired on first visit.

services.title: Fault Finding & Repairs
services.desc: Faulty sockets, flickering lights, circuit issues — we'll track down the problem and fix it safely. Full diagnostics included.

services.title: Complete Rewires & Upgrades
services.desc: Old wiring causing safety concerns? We carry out full house rewires to Building Regulations, with certification included.

services.title: Consumer Unit Replacement
services.desc: Upgrade or replace your fusebox with a modern consumer unit. We install to the latest standards and test every connection.

services.title: PAT Testing & Inspections
services.desc: Annual portable appliance testing and electrical installation condition reports for your peace of mind and safety compliance.

services.title: New Installations & Additions
services.desc: Adding circuits for new kitchens, bathrooms, or garden installations. All work certified and signed off.

about_pullquote: We treat every job like it's our own home. Safety and honesty come first, always.
about_para_1: West Park Electrics has been serving Leeds households and small businesses for over 15 years. We started because we saw too many corners being cut on electrical work — dodgy wiring, unsafe installations, overpricing. We decided to do it differently: honest pricing, proper qualifications, and work that meets Building Regulations every time.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on showing up on time, doing the job right first time, and explaining what we're doing as we go. Customers come back to us because they trust us. We're NICEIC approved, fully insured, and we carry all our tools and parts on the van so we can often solve problems the same day we arrive.
reviews_heading: What Leeds Customers Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a complete rewire done on a 1960s semi. The lads were tidy, professional, and finished on schedule. Everything tested and certified properly. Great work and competitive price. Really pleased.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: Called them at 11 pm with a tripped electrics issue. They answered straight away and were round within the hour. Fixed a faulty RCD in 20 minutes. Professional, friendly, and fair pricing. Couldn't ask for better.
reviews.author: Emma K.

reviews.text: West Park have done several jobs for us over the years — sockets, lights, PAT testing. Always reliable, always honest about what needs doing. They don't hard sell you stuff you don't need. Proper tradesmen.
reviews.author: Michael R.
